recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If characteristicExpression itself needs future changes, handle them in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than reintroducing the extension definition into core.
issue_request: FHIR-24849 was a Published FHIR-core Group change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It requested a new Group.characteristicCombination code element for intersection/AND versus union/OR behavior across multiple Group.characteristic instances, but the accepted resolution chose sub-groups plus a characteristicExpression extension for more complex FHIRPath or CQL membership criteria when Group.characteristic is omitted.
initial_application: Commit ac71406c7854b22379672089a4c8883e19268714 applied FHIR-24849 by adding characteristicExpression to source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml for Group. It did not add a core Group.characteristicCombination element. The broad R5 extension migration in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions from core, and characteristicExpression now exists in the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: Group is active in source/fhir.ini and current source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml defines Group.combinationMethod and Group.combinationThreshold, with all-of/any-of semantics and required binding to group-characteristic-combination. Later Applied issue FHIR-41583 explains that current conceptual CohortDefinition model. The Extension Pack definition preserves the accepted characteristicExpression mechanism as a Group-scoped extension exclusive with Group.characteristic. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence, while FHIR-I minutes corroborate the Jira resolution.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because adding the originally requested element would conflict with the accepted modification and current Group model, while the accepted extension mechanism is maintained outside the core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Group conceptual CohortDefinition work added the current Group.combinationMethod and Group.combinationThreshold model that covers AND/OR characteristic combinations in core.
